sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C12265 and card C12265-K2. Between 2016-12-03 and 2016-12-03, 1 transaction(s) totalling $125.08 were identified as part of one suspicious episode (3509359). The activity was online (card not present) and the alert was raised by a bank model risk score of 0.52 on transaction 3509359. The activity is assessed as an undocumented pattern with a fraud probability of 0.96. Product code R never used on this card before. Device ring: 38 other customers' cards used the same fully specified device profile in the last 30 days, each with window transactions whose identity record marks the device New. 2 earlier confirmed-fraud closed case(s) on this card, closed before the alert. The same origin links this card to 25 other card(s): C00854-K2, C00989-K1, C01138-K2, C01419-K1, C02171-K1, C02393-K2. A simulated step up auth response was recorded as 'deny'. It is suspicious because Product code R never used on this card before; Device ring: 38 other customers' cards used the same fully specified device profile in the last 30 days, each with window transactions whose identity record marks the device New. Recommended actions: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST. All amounts are in USD; product codes and region codes are dataset codes, and no merchant identifiers exist in the data.
